visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a blue and white striped button-down shirt, sits in a restaurant. She holds a small clear glass cup and drinks from it, smiling warmly at the camera. The background features a brick wall, hanging lanterns, and a large painting of koi fish. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of the restaurant, showing a sign that reads 'HAMONO SUSHI' with a logo of a circle and a fish. The building is made of orange brick. This is followed by a shot of an urban street lined with vibrant red autumnal trees under a clear blue sky. (3) Returning to the interior, the ceiling is decorated with dense pink cherry blossom replicas and red traditional Japanese umbrellas. A chalkboard sign outside the entrance lists 'Omakase unlimited $100'. (4) The woman is seen again, gesturing with chopsticks. Several close-up shots of food follow, including a clear soup with large pieces of shrimp, various pieces of nigiri sushi (tuna, salmon with roe, wagyu beef with scallions), and a small bowl containing sea urchin (uni) and salmon roe. (5) The woman eats a piece of sushi and gives a thumbs up. A man in a grey sweater is seen in the background. A green bottle of sake is shown being held and poured into a small glass. Later, a black bottle with a yellow 'MACHO' label featuring a muscular cartoon character is presented. (6) A physical menu is displayed, listing various sushi and kitchen items. More food shots follow: grilled skewers, tempura, and a rice bowl topped with diced fish and mayonnaise. The woman continues to eat, showing a fish-shaped pastry (taiyaki) and matcha ice cream for dessert. (7) In the final moments, the woman holds two small packets labeled 'coft' and 'SOS' in front of the camera before holding up a final piece of sushi on her chopsticks.
